nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Wren digs through a crate of junk at Ferrows Odds and Ends and finds a chess set with 33 pieces instead of 32. The extra piece is a black knight carved like a real snorting horse, not the boxy L-shape of the rest, and it smells of cedar, not walnut.'>>

choices.label: Take a closer look at the odd knight

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Wren is sure the cedar knight does not belong with the rest of the walnut set. Decide how to start figuring out where it really came from.'>>

choices.label: Ask Mrs. Ferrow where the set came from
Dig through the rest of the crate for clues
Turn the knight over to check for a maker's mark

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Whichever way Wren starts, the search turns up the same thing: tiny initials, E period O period, scratched into the felt under the knight's base, half worn away but still readable.'>>

choices.label: Try to trace the initials E.O.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Two letters are not much to go on. Wren weighs where to look first for someone whose initials are E.O.'>>

choices.label: Search the shop's old sale ledger
Ask the old men at the park chess tables
Check the town library's newspaper archive

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='The ledger turns up a name: Eli Okafor, a woodcarver who once lived in town and made chess sets to order. Decide how far to push this lead.'>>

choices.label: Accept the ledger's story and write it up
Ask Mrs. Ferrow to explain the entry
Cross-reference the name against other records

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Cross-referencing the ledger name turns up three different leads at once. Decide which one to chase.'>>

choices.label: Follow the name to a bakery downtown
Follow it to a rival collector's shop
Follow it to Eli's old boarded-up workshop

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='An old regular named Mr. Pell remembers being Eli Okafor's chess student decades ago. Decide how far to push this lead.'>>

choices.label: Take Mr. Pell's word for it
Ask to see his old club roster
Ask him to introduce more old members

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='The other old members each have a different piece of the Eli Okafor story to offer. Decide which one to listen to.'>>

choices.label: Hear about the workshop fire
Hear about Eli's granddaughter
Hear about a rival collector asking questions

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='An old newspaper article turns up, mentioning a woodcarver named Eli Okafor and a workshop fire. Decide how far to push this lead.'>>

choices.label: Read the article and call it settled
Ask the archivist for old photographs
Chase the fire department report the article mentions

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='The old fire department report has three different details worth following up on. Decide which one matters most.'>>

choices.label: Learn the set almost burned entirely
Learn what firefighters recovered that night
Learn the sale date lines up with the fire

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The ledger entry is enough for Wren: Eli Okafor made the set, and the cedar knight is proof of his work, even without meeting anyone who knew him.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Mrs. Ferrow squints at the old entry and remembers buying the crate from an estate sale years back, filling in one more piece of the story.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The trail leads to a bakery run by Eli Okafor's granddaughter, who is thrilled to learn a piece of her grandfather's last set survived.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='A rival collector named Mr. Grieve got to the same lead first and is cagey about what he knows, leaving Wren a step behind.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The trail ends at Eli's old boarded-up workshop behind the hardware store, with no way inside today, and the search has to wait.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Wren trusts Mr. Pell's memory of his old teacher and writes up the story of the cedar knight, satisfied with a good secondhand account.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The old club roster confirms Eli Okafor really was a member decades ago, closing the loop neatly with a name and a date.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Wren hears secondhand about the workshop fire that ended Eli's carving, a sad but useful detail that explains a lot.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Wren learns Eli had a granddaughter still living in town, a promising new lead to chase another day.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The old members warn Wren that a rival collector has been asking the same questions, which makes the whole search feel more urgent.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The newspaper article is enough to satisfy Wren's curiosity for now, even without tracking down a living person who remembers Eli.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Old photographs bring the workshop to life exactly as it looked before the fire, tools lined up and a chessboard half-carved on the bench.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The report makes clear the whole set almost burned along with the workshop, a sobering thought that puts the surviving knight in perspective.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The recovery list names a single chess piece pulled from the ashes that night, and Wren realizes it is the very knight sitting in a pocket right now.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Chasing the fire report takes so long that Wren gets home late and grounded, the last details of the mystery left for another weekend.'>>
